billing.title: Plan and billing
billing.description: Your plan, usage against limits, invoices and payment method.
billing.portalUnavailable: The Stripe portal (payment method, tax details and invoices) becomes available once Stripe is configured.
billing.ownerOnly: Only the organization owner can change the plan or manage payments.

testMode.title: Billing in test mode
testMode.banner: Stripe is not configured. Subscriptions and purchases are simulated without charges and follow exactly the same flow as with Stripe.

alerts.pastDue: Update your payment method before {date} to avoid read-only mode.
alerts.readOnly: Your projects and data are still available, but nothing can run or be edited. Choose a plan to continue.
alerts.trialExpired: The trial has ended. Choose a plan to run, edit and deploy again.
alerts.canceling: The subscription ends on {date}. Everything keeps working until then.

current.title: Current plan
current.trialUntil: Free trial until {date} ({days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}})
current.choosePlanHint: Choose a plan to keep your projects running when the trial ends.
current.cancelDescription: You keep full access until {date}. After that the organization becomes read-only.
current.cancelScheduled: The subscription will be canceled at the end of the period.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Prices exclude VAT. VAT is calculated for your country at checkout.
plans.confirmDescription: The change is immediate. The current period is prorated; afterwards you pay {amount} / {interval} + VAT.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: VAT invoices for every period and for credit purchases.
invoices.emptyDescription: They appear here once you subscribe to a plan or buy credits.

checkout.title: Confirm payment
checkout.testNotice: Test mode — no charge will be made
checkout.testExplanation: Stripe is not configured. When you confirm, Messer processes the same events Stripe would send (subscription, invoice and credits) without asking for a card or charging anything.
checkout.vatNote: Amount excludes VAT. With Stripe configured, Stripe Tax calculates VAT for your country.
checkout.successToast: Payment completed. Your plan is now active.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: Credits pay for AI model usage. Each credit is worth {value}: model cost plus the service margin.
credits.exhausted: Runs are stopped. Buy a pack or enable automatic top-up.
credits.low: Buy a pack or enable automatic top-up so your agents don't stop.
credits.buyDescription: Packs are added to your balance and never expire.

autoTopup.title: Automatic top-up
autoTopup.description: Buy a pack automatically when the balance drops below the threshold, using the saved payment method.
autoTopup.needsPaymentMethod: You need a saved payment method: subscribe to a plan or buy a pack first.
autoTopup.threshold: Top up when the balance drops below
autoTopup.thresholdHint: In credits. At most one top-up every 10 minutes and five per day.

last.pending: Last top-up requested on {date}, awaiting confirmation.

ledger.title: Transactions
ledger.description: Everything that adds or removes credits: plan allowance, purchases, usage and adjustments.
ledger.emptyDescription: There are no transactions of this type.

budgets.description: Cap AI model spend per organization and per project. We warn at the threshold and, with hard stop, new runs are refused once the limit is reached.
budgets.formDescription: Spend is the real model cost (USD) of the period's runs.
budgets.limitInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
budgets.thresholdHint: Admins get an email and a notification, once per period.
budgets.hardStopHint: Once the limit is reached, new runs are refused until the next period.
budgets.emptyDescription: Create a budget for the organization or a project and get warned before overspending.
budgets.deleteDescription: Its alerts and hard stop will no longer apply. This action is audited.
budgets.footnote: Periods are computed in UTC. Spend includes every run in scope, from any channel.

upgrade.featureTitle: Your plan doesn't include this feature
upgrade.askOwner: Ask the organization owner to change the plan.
